sample_unit: patients (CCT examinations in the rater-annotated test subset)
models_evaluated: convolutional neural network for ICH detection on cranial CT (commercial AI engine)

links.outcome: AI ICH detection performance versus two expert raters on real-world local test data
links.effect: On 255 patients, AI sensitivity 0.90, specificity 0.96, accuracy 0.96; inter-rater agreement 0.84, 0.98, 0.96.
links.quote: Comparing the AI's performance on a subset of 255 patients with two expert raters, it achieved a sensitivity of 0.90, a specificity of 0.96, an accuracy of 0.96.

links.outcome: AI performance validated across three pilot sites, with processing times reported per center
links.effect: Deployed at three German centers; median processing times 9, 11, and 12 min. Accuracy was reported for the pooled subset.
links.quote: The overall median processing times for the three centers were 9, 11, and 12 min, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the prospective real-world deployment and diagnostic turnaround time/accuracy of an integrated CNN for detecting intracranial hemorrhage across three clinical centers without comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
